Half that blocker was cleared the same night; the other half was found hours later and is larger.

what_is_already_DONE_and_must_not_be_re-.simulator_real.py + simulator_real_trail: FIXED and committed 2026-08-12. All three stop sites in each file (pre-TP1 premium stop, post-TP1 conservative BE stop, post-TP1 aggressive stop) now pay exit_slippage. what_remains_and_is_the_subject_of_this_: A: exit_manager_walk.py fills 6 of 9 exit stages at the EXACT triggered premium with zero slippage (tp1, runner_target, premium_stop, profit_lock_floor, trail, be_stop). Only _MARKET_STAGES (time_stop, ribbon_flip, structure_stop) pay DEFAULT_EXIT_SLIPPAGE.

B: DEFAULT_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE / DEFAULT_EXIT_SLIPPAGE = 0.02 in simulator_real.py, versus a measured SPY-0DTE half-spread of $0.0104 (Roll estimator over 554,198 RTH ticks) and an independent broker-fill calibration of 0.01.
C: fees are modelled as $0. Measured $0.0304/contract-side. They cut the OPPOSITE way to a slippage reduction.

the_hazard_this_prereg_exists_to_contain.distinct_from_the_2026-08-12_prereg: That one contained ONE hazard: a friction change laundering a kill. This one contains that PLUS a sequencing hazard the earlier study could not have hit, because item A was not yet known.
the_hazard_this_prereg_exists_to_contain.sequencing_hazard: Re-baselining slippage (B) on top of an ASYMMETRIC fill model (A) does not reduce error, it relocates it. exit_manager_walk's 6 zero-slippage stages make its P&L partly INSENSITIVE to the slippage constant, so lowering the constant moves market-exit cells and leaves limit-style cells nearly still. The resulting before/after table would look like a clean friction effect and would actually be a mixture of two different things. ORDER IS THEREFORE PART OF THE PREREGISTRATION, not an implementation detail.
the_hazard_this_prereg_exists_to_contain.offsetting_hazard: B alone is favourable to every cell; C alone is unfavourable to every cell. Shipping B without C produces a one-sided improvement that is an artifact of partial modelling, not a better model. They must land in the SAME commit.
the_hazard_this_prereg_exists_to_contain.laundering_hazard_inherited_verbatim: A SIGN FLIP IS NOT A RESURRECTION. No cell is re-armed, un-killed, or described as 'now profitable' by this work. The maximum output for any flipped cell is: candidate for re-validation through the normal gate stack, on its own evidence, later.

mandatory_order_of_operations: STEP 1 -- fix A (exit_manager_walk fill model) with the slippage constants UNCHANGED at 0.02. Publish the A-only delta. This isolates the fill-model effect from the friction effect.
STEP 2 -- only after STEP 1's table exists: change B and C together in one commit. Publish the (B+C)-only delta measured from STEP 1's post-fix baseline.
STEP 3 -- publish the combined A+B+C delta versus the pre-2026-08-13 baseline, and state explicitly that it is the composition of steps 1 and 2, not an independent measurement.

A run that changes A, B and C simultaneously is INVALID under this prereg regardless of what it shows. The three effects are not separable after the fact -- the 2026-08-12 study already demonstrated that 54.3% of exit-mix distributions shift between arms, so path divergence would be indistinguishable from friction.

population.definition: Every verdict-bearing script whose artifact still exists under analysis/ or strategy/ AND whose P&L flows through exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager or simulator_real*/simulate_trade_real* without an explicit slippage kwarg.
population.known_scale: ~95 files contain a genuine walk_exit_manager( call (grep files_with_matches over backtest/, verified 2026-08-12); the module self-describes '80+ call sites'. The simulate_trade_real side was AST-measured at 195 call sites / 166 default-consuming / 78 verdict-bearing scripts -- the widely-quoted '241 studies' was a raw grep of call sites and is WRONG.
population.counting_rule: Report scripts that WRITE A VERDICT, never raw call sites. Conflating the two is the specific error this line exists to prevent.

validity_gates_that_must_pass_before_any.G1_control_arm_reproduces: Re-running the unchanged code must reproduce each published verdict EXACTLY. The 2026-08-12 study achieved this on all 4 Tier-A cells and it is the only thing that makes a delta interpretable.
validity_gates_that_must_pass_before_any.G2_rng_noise_floor: Two identical runs must differ in 0 keys. Measured 0/339 on 2026-08-12; re-measure, do not assume.
validity_gates_that_must_pass_before_any.G3_write_sandbox: No published verdict, no automation/state/* file, and no module default may be mutated by the measurement runs themselves.
validity_gates_that_must_pass_before_any.G4_patch_binds: Vary-and-assert: the fill-model change must produce a non-zero delta wherever the affected exit stages actually occur in the population. A zero delta everywhere means the patch did not bind (C14), not that the bug was harmless.
validity_gates_that_must_pass_before_any.G5_input_freshness: watcher-observations.jsonl is a ROLLING file that holds ~one day; studies reading it silently emit verdicts at n=0. Any cell whose n is 0 or whose population is empty is reported as NOT-RUN, never as a result.

direction_sanity_check.A_fill_model: Charging slippage on 6 previously-free exit stages can only REDUCE realised P&L on cells that use them. Any cell that IMPROVES under A alone is an anomaly and must be explained before the table is published.
direction_sanity_check.B_slippage_2c_to_1c: Halving friction can only IMPROVE cells, NOW that the simulator_real asymmetry is fixed. Before that fix the sign was mixed -- that non-monotonicity was the bug. If any cell WORSENS under B alone, a zero-slippage path remains somewhere and must be found before proceeding.
direction_sanity_check.C_fees: Adding a real per-contract-side fee can only REDUCE P&L. Any improvement is an anomaly.
direction_sanity_check.why_this_matters: These three one-way predictions are the cheapest possible falsification test of the implementation. This repo has already retracted one 'errs conservative' claim about this exact code; a stated direction that the data violates is the signal that the model is still wrong.

necessary_and_not_sufficient: The cell reproduces exactly under G1.

Its kill basis is one that friction can actually move -- P&L or expectancy. NOT win-rate-threshold, NOT random_null (mathematically invariant: the null is simulated under the same friction, so both arms shift together), NOT concentration, truncation, frequency, look-ahead or edge_capture.

The flip is not a single-trade exit-path reclassification -- the 2026-08-12 study found one cell swinging +$80.64/trade against a ~$6/trade arithmetic bound purely because one trade moved LEVEL_STOP -> TP1_RUNNER_RIBBON.
what_would_make_me_RECOMMEND_revisiting_.prior: 14 of 20 killed cells cite at least one gate friction cannot move; only 2 died on a purely friction-movable basis, both on win rate. The expected number of legitimate revivals is approximately zero, and a result claiming many should be treated as evidence of an implementation error.

aggregate_to_quantify.forbidden: A naive sum across cells. On 2026-08-12 that produced $1.38M, which is meaningless -- it double-counts nested keys across mutually exclusive grid cells. Publishing it would have been a fabricated headline.
aggregate_to_quantify.required: Per-cell deltas only, plus a count of cells by direction and a median per-trade delta within each of the three steps.

ship_rule.what_this_produces: Three before/after tables (A, B+C, combined) and a scorecard. NOTHING is armed, un-killed, or re-config'd by this study.
ship_rule.live_config: automation/state/* is READ-ONLY for this entire study.
ship_rule.module_defaults: Changing DEFAULT_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE / DEFAULT_EXIT_SLIPPAGE is IN scope here (it is item B) but only in STEP 2, only alongside fees, and only after STEP 1's table exists.

reporting_rule.all_cells: Report every cell, including unchanged and NOT-RUN ones. Reporting only movers is selection.
reporting_rule.not_run_is_not_a_pass: A cell that could not execute is NOT-RUN, never a null result. Conflating 'could not attempt' with 'attempted and found nothing' is a documented failure class here.
reporting_rule.provenance_stamp: Every published table carries the git HEAD it was produced at and the prereg_id, so a downstream consumer cannot inherit soundness sight-unseen.
